visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a light blue short-sleeved button-up shirt over a grey t-shirt and blue denim jeans, stands in front of a vibrant yellow wall adorned with numerous photos of smiling children and colorful sticky notes. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor exhibition space featuring large, clear acrylic bubbles suspended from the ceiling. The man walks through the space, interacting with various exhibits. He is seen wearing a headset microphone and looking at a digital interface on a tablet. (3) The man engages with an eye-tracking technology demonstration. He sits in a chair equipped with specialized headrests and monitors. A close-up shows his eyes focusing on a screen that displays interactive icons and a game interface. (4) He approaches a set of transparent gacha machines, inserts a token, and turns the knob. He retrieves a small purple capsule, opens it, and reads a yellow speech-bubble-shaped note. The video concludes with him gesturing toward the exhibition entrance signage which reads 'Beyond the Ordinary'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 成為目光的魔法 支持改變發生. [Subtitle]: 你有想過. (2) [Subtitle]: 當身體受限 卻渴望表達 我們能用什麼樣的方式 讓世界聽見 心裡的聲音嗎. (3) [Slogan]: 尋常之外 BEYOND THE ORDINARY. [Subtitle]: 今天我們來華山 看展囉 由目目非營利舉辦的 《尋常之外》 出發吧. (4) [Subtitle]: 這次的展覽 《尋常之外》 以目光翻越日常邊界 開啟一場用眼睛交流 用心感受的旅程. (5) [Subtitle]: 踏入展區啊 發現原來稀鬆的 日常行動 對一些人來說可是 遙不可及的遠方. (6) [Subtitle]: 透過了罩子 聽見了 重度肢體障礙者 跟家人的心聲 更讓我珍惜 我所能做到的日常. (7) [Subtitle]: 接著走下去啊 你會瞭解 目光其實 像魔法一樣 穿越了現實邊界. (8) [Subtitle]: 使用眼動輔具 幫助重度肢體障礙者 以目光與他人溝通. (9) [Subtitle]: 透過紅外線鏡頭 還有系統計算 讓使用者 以凝視和掃視的方式 來操作電腦. (10) [Subtitle]: 現場甚至還有遊戲 可以來體驗哦. (11) [Subtitle]: 最後還可以 留下你的鼓勵 還有抽扭蛋 來換取障礙者分享 真的又是 讓我好感動啊. (12) [Subtitle]: 工作時 我嘗試各種方法 呈現腦海中的畫面或笑點 這樣的時刻是自由的. (13) [Subtitle]: 讓我們一起來 目目非營利的 尋常之外 展覽 自由體驗 眼動科技的 溫柔創新 一起翻越日常邊界吧.
